purpose: Prepared for final closeout; these are planning proposals, not selected contracts or executed investigations.
ranking_basis: Relevance to named missing obligations, followed by the value of a bounded discriminating result. Ranks are not success probabilities, proof percentages or equal units of work.
second_loop_rule: Every second loop remains unselected until the first loop is reviewed and the advisor chooses from its actual evidence and objections.
dependency_note: All dependencies except r28-ak2 were checked in the immutable nine-gate network. r28-ak2 must be validated against the final network after gate ten.

next_goals.title: Test the full model and physical-scale bridge
next_goals.target: Determine whether one explicitly specified standard lattice Yang–Mills scaling family can be matched to the complete I1 Hamiltonian and its physical clock within the admitted hypotheses, or establish the precise obstruction for that proposed bridge.
next_goals.exact_model: Compare the untruncated SU(2) spatial-lattice Hamiltonian with uniform plaquette coefficients to the actual I1 selected-strip reference plus homogeneous omitted interaction, link by link and plaquette by plaquette. Freeze the physical electric and magnetic coefficients, positive a, alpha, hbar and E_star before examining one specified a-to-zero family. No summable profile or conditional diffusion clock may substitute for either side.
next_goals.missing_premise: A proved full-generator/observable/energy dictionary and an admissible scaling path with the required short-distance regime and positive physical mass scale; matching notation or a finite fixed-spacing gap is insufficient.
next_goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one candidate coefficient and observable map using the applicable primary definition. Check every selected and omitted original plaquette, kinetic normalization, ground subtraction and clock, then test the entire proposed parameter path against both actual I1 smallness conditions. Compare explicitly with the already recorded R18-B2 bare-coupling obstruction so its old inequality is not relabeled new. Admit only a new complete bridge statement or a scoped failure of this candidate; do not claim a continuum limit from membership alone.
next_goals.reason_for_rank: It determines whether the controlled lattice regime can address the intended continuum problem before further optimization of that regime.

next_goals.title: Evaluate a complete-model homogeneous stability interval
next_goals.target: Obtain a certified positive numerical omitted-coupling interval for the complete original I1 Hamiltonian, or identify the exact unevaluated proof constant or complete-iteration obstruction.
next_goals.exact_model: The nonsummable I1 homogeneous omitted interaction on complete 24-link coarse factors, its selected-strip coefficient ranges, four-site whole stars and specified boundary family, at fixed positive physical scales. The physical gauge restriction remains the actual AJ1 representation.
next_goals.missing_premise: Numerically evaluated positive stability constants for the complete original model. The AG3 changed-weight step neither evaluates tau_* nor proves a complete all-stage correction.
next_goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze the actual I1 source theorem and its proof version. Try to give explicit positive bounds for every constant entering its fixed-star smallness threshold, with complete domain, range, incidence, scalar and retained-diagonal hypotheses. Require the entire quantitative implication, including any infinite majorant used, before declaring a radius. Zero source, omitted incoming stars and a retained-diagonal deletion must be discriminating controls. If a source constant remains unevaluated, name it and retain an insufficient numerical-interval verdict rather than assign a convenient epsilon.
next_goals.reason_for_rank: It would make an existing qualitative complete-model theorem quantitatively usable; repeating another symbolic small-coupling application would not change the result.

next_goals.title: Compare two precisely defined homogeneous bulk limits
next_goals.target: Determine whether deep-bulk translates of the actual orthant state and one specified centered-box construction give the same local physical state. The claim is restricted to those two routes, not all boundaries.
next_goals.exact_model: The same untruncated homogeneous omitted-interaction assignment and selected-strip reference extended with a fixed coarse translation convention. Compare the existing positive-orthant state on translated local observables with predeclared centered whole-star boxes, keeping each tested complete factor region at a distance tending to infinity from every boundary and preserving all original endpoint gauge actions.
next_goals.missing_premise: A controlled boundary-distance estimate and identification of the two actual local-state limits. A fixed-origin orthant observable is not automatically a bulk observable, and a common spectral gap does not identify distinct states.
next_goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one finite complete factor region and the two volume/translation sequences. Prove a bound tending to zero for the difference of their expectations uniformly over the norm-one bounded local gauge-invariant algebra on that region, or isolate why the selected comparison bound fails. Audit the archive and the source theorem for already inherited boundary claims first. Retain a near-boundary control and a deliberately changed interaction boundary; finite-volume agreement alone is insufficient.
next_goals.reason_for_rank: This addresses the specified orthant construction's remaining relation to a bulk theory, rather than treating a boundary-local spectral witness as that identification.

next_goals.title: Decide whether the Wilson energy identity survives the limit
next_goals.target: For the same Wilson excitation, establish sufficient uniform integrability or a source-qualified form-convergence result to transfer the finite first-moment identity as an equality, or identify the precise obstruction in the proposed route.
next_goals.exact_model: Only the actual I1/AJ1/AJ2/AK1/AK2 homogeneous whole-star positive-orthant state, original origin xz Wilson, 48-link/36-endpoint cover, centered finite and limiting physical generators, fixed positive scales and both inherited coupling restrictions.
next_goals.missing_premise: Control preventing physical first-moment mass from escaping to arbitrarily high energy. AK2 supplies an upper bound and form-domain membership, but not uniform integrability, limiting moment equality, an operator domain or a second moment.
next_goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one same-Wilson energy-tail or form-convergence route and test whether it proves uniform integrability of the finite physical first-moment measures over the specified volumes. Any use of the admitted local reference-energy bound must justify its relation to the excited-vector physical energy. The already admitted escaping-moment countermeasure must invalidate an argument using bounded first moments and resolvent tests alone. No new second moment or tail estimate is a premise, and failure of one sufficient route is not proof of actual moment loss.
next_goals.reason_for_rank: This is Newton's bounded follow-up to a real AK2 limitation, but the contracted spectral window already follows without equality and a sharper fixed-lattice moment is not a continuum construction.

next_goals.title: Test canonical inference at a design chosen from prior information
next_goals.target: Obtain a valid decision or set of compatible parameters for two declared canonical candidate classes whose nuisance parameters vary independently, using one measurement design fixed from a coarse prior; permit an explicitly unresolved outcome.
next_goals.exact_model: The admitted canonical summable full-link SU(2) family with the actual B4/B5 Wilson multiplication data and its complete state, collar and averaging errors. Freeze a compact prior family, independent physical time reference, known or uncertain alpha and carrier phase, and their error conventions. This is not the homogeneous I1 state or an empirical apparatus.
next_goals.missing_premise: A clock, resource schedule and decision rule independent of the exact unknown parameter, together with separation or certified localization across independently varying candidates. AI4's same-u pair separation is insufficient.
next_goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze one coarse prior band, actual scalar data vector, physical timestamps, complete supports and deterministic error budget before inspecting outcomes. Test two distinct quantifiers: first, whether the single design selected only from the prior supports a band-wide same-u comparison; separately, whether one rule using only that prior and measured data discriminates independently varying cross-candidates on the continuous domain. Passing the first test alone is a limited design result, not composite-family inference. Keep all physical error terms and denominator conditions, and retain a ratio-versus-raw-data control. If sufficient enclosures overlap, report an unresolved region without asserting identical actual outputs or impossible inference.
next_goals.reason_for_rank: It directly addresses an admitted information-content limitation. Its result would improve inference within the canonical model, while leaving continuum matching and the homogeneous proof obligations separate.

unselected_alternatives.title: Execute a certified 561-state heat evaluator
unselected_alternatives.exact_model: The fixed AH open 3-by-2-by-1 full physical graph, its exact Haar metric and 561-state generated span, and its declared normalized complex vacuum-near P0 preparation class.
unselected_alternatives.missing_premise: An actually exported numerical heat vector or evaluator with separate polynomial, ground-center, coordinate-export and full-system error certificates; AH2 bounds exact semigroups.
unselected_alternatives.possible_first_question: At one prospectively frozen coupling and physical time, can independent numerical formulations export all 561 coordinates and agree in the actual Gram metric within their certified errors while retaining the true full-output denominator?
unselected_alternatives.reason_unselected: A useful computational deliverable, but lower priority for the current continuum-oriented obligation review. An all-time evaluator would require a later adaptive decision; no output was computed by this panel review.
